meta.name: memory-management
meta.description: Use when the user asks to "remember project context"; manages the cross-discipline marketing memory lifecycle (SEO/GEO + influencer + paid ads) — hot-cache, active work, archive tiers, and privacy cleanup. Not for content or domain scoring — use the auditors. 项目记忆/跨会话

copy.tagline: 管理跨会话营销项目记忆，自动分层缓存与清理
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在多个营销渠道间保持项目上下文一致
copy.tagline_en: Manage cross-session marketing project memory with automatic tiered caching and cleanup
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to maintain consistent project context across multiple marketing channels

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会管理一个三层记忆系统（热/温/冷），自动加载热缓存、按需加载温缓存、归档冷数据。它还能处理记忆的查询、升级、降级、归档和隐私清理。
howto.when: 当你要求“记住项目上下文”、检查已保存的发现、管理热缓存、归档旧数据或执行记忆清理时触发。

say.text: 为[项目名]设置营销记忆结构。
say.note: 初始化新项目的记忆目录和热缓存。

say.text: 将[关键词]升级到热缓存。
say.note: 把指定关键词加入热缓存，便于快速访问。

say.text: 清理记忆：删除[实体名]的所有记录。
say.note: 触发 GDPR 删除流程，需用户确认。

howto.what_en: Claude manages a three-tier memory system (hot/warm/cold): auto-loads hot cache each session, loads warm memory on demand, archives cold data. It handles query, promote, demote, archive, and privacy cleanup.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to 'remember project context', check saved findings, manage hot cache, archive old data, or perform memory cleanup.

say_en.text: Set up marketing memory for [project name].
say_en.note: Initializes memory directories and hot cache for a new project.
Moves the keyword to hot cache for quick access.

say_en.text: Purge memory: delete all records for [entity name].
say_en.note: Triggers GDPR deletion flow, requires user confirmation.
